lines.text: Twelve floors... on every hospital blueprint.
Thirteen buttons... inside the brass elevator.
Wait until you hear... who it actually stops for.
For ninety-nine nights, Maya filmed empty hallways... to prove ghosts weren't real.
Just dust. Zero views. Zero ghosts.
Until a leaked nurse's comment dared her into Millbrook Wing B... at two forty-seven AM.
lines.caps: A LEAKED *DARE: | MILLBROOK *WING B | at *2:47 AM.

lines.text: Inside the locked lobby, she found three yellowed rules... taped by the watchman.
Rule one... never enter an open morgue door.
Rule two... if the elevator moves alone, never look in the mirror.
Rule three: Floor thirteen was sealed in seventy-eight. If the speaker calls your name... do not answer.
Down the basement corridor, freezing air spilled through steel doors... standing three inches ajar.
Night one hundred... wait, why is the morgue door unlocked?
Maya crept closer... and pulled the cold brass bar.
Her phone screen blinked once. One percent battery.
Then... pitch black.
Hello? Is someone down here?
Behind her, warm brass elevator doors rolled smoothly open. She stepped inside... and they slammed shut.
Floor one... five... twelve. Then she looked up... at the mirror...
And froze. Inside the glass... the elevator was completely empty.
Wait, where am I? Why can't I see myself?!
lines.caps: *WHERE AM I?! | Why can't I *see myself?!

lines.text: Maya Chen. You were never supposed to find this. Welcome to Floor thirteen.
The doors parted into endless darkness, revealing an old iron mailbox holding her own file... stamped deceased, nineteen seventy-eight.
She's yours now.
What... what's happening to my hands?!
Behind her in the glass... hollow black eyes smiled back. That wasn't Maya.
You're trapped on Floor thirteen. Do you sprint through the exit doors, or grab the glowing keycard?
Comment A or B right now. Follow so you don't miss Part Two.
